URL: https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/guides/ai-translation-captioning-buyers-guide
Title: AI Translation & Captioning Buyer’s Guide | Snapsight

Buyer’s guide · AI translation and live captions

# How to choose AI translation and captions for your event.

The questions to ask vendors, the checks that predict quality on the day, and the red flags. All on this page.

[Book a demo](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/contact?interest=translation) Start with the 12 questions

## Get the guide by email

The full guide adds when to choose AI or an interpreter, and an RFP you can paste into a vendor email.

[Request the guide by email](mailto:cs@snapsight.com?subject=AI%20translation%20buyers%20guide)

## Twelve questions to ask every vendor.

Score each answer 0 to 2. The highest of 24 is your shortlist.

Ask for answers in writing. They tell you more than any demo.

Coverage and accuracy

1. *1* How many languages, and does translation work in every direction?
2. *2* How is accuracy measured, and on what?
3. *3* Can we add a custom glossary for names and terms?
4. *4* Can we download transcripts in every language?

Fit and experience

1. *5* Does it work with our meeting platform and on-site AV?
2. *6* How long does it take to go live?
3. *7* What do attendees have to install?
4. *8* Which browsers and devices does it support?

Trust and proof

1. *9* Do the captions meet WCAG 2.1 AA?
2. *10* Is the platform SOC 2 Type II audited?
3. *11* Is our content used to train your models?
4. *12* Can we speak to events like ours?

Vendor A: **0** of 24 · 0 of 12 answered

**0** No or unclear **1** Partly **2** Yes, in writing

## Test these five on your own sessions.

A polished demo proves little. A live trial with your audio does.

1. **Clean audio in** A feed from the sound desk or close mics. Room audio is where most errors start.
2. **Every language, both ways** Speakers switch languages. Translation should follow them, not only from English.
3. **Audio and captions together** Some attendees want to read, others to listen. Offer both.
4. **A glossary you control** Boost, block and replace terms, so names and acronyms come out right.
5. **Nothing to install** No app and no account. A link or QR code should be enough.

![Laptop screen showing a Snapsight live capture session in progress, with Sound Check and Stop buttons](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/assets/audio-feed-laptop-C7wpPTQo.webp)

Audio feed from the sound desk · IMEX Frankfurt

## Eight red flags that should end the conversation.

Any one of them outweighs a good score.

1. *1* Your content trains their language models.
2. *2* Attendees must download an app or create an account.
3. *3* It only works with one meeting platform.
4. *4* No live trial and no accuracy benchmark.
5. *5* They can’t explain their security controls.
6. *6* Per-language or per-session charges are hidden.
7. *7* Setup is measured in months, not days.
8. *8* Your content disappears when the event ends.

[Compare the cost with interpreters](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/tools/event-translation-cost-calculator) [How Snapsight handles your content](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/security)

## Put Snapsight through all twelve.

Bring your questions and a session of your own to a demo.

[Book a demo](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/contact?interest=translation) [Start free](https://www.snapsight.com/signup)

## Frequently asked questions

### What should you ask an AI translation vendor before buying?

Twelve questions, grouped in three. Coverage and accuracy: how many languages and whether translation works in every direction, how accuracy is measured, custom glossaries, and transcripts in every language. Fit and experience: platform integrations, time to go live, what attendees must install, and device support. Trust and proof: WCAG 2.1 AA captions, independent security audits, whether your data trains their models, and references from events like yours.

### When is a human interpreter better than AI translation?

For flagship, high-stakes, heavily planned sessions where certified accuracy and cultural nuance matter, legal and diplomatic settings especially. For recurring and multi-track events, compare AI on the language pairs, audio conditions and attendee needs you actually have, and test both reading and listening before deciding.

### Should a medical congress use AI translation or interpreters?

Test AI on your own sessions before deciding. Medical talks are dense, so add drug names, trial acronyms and speaker names as custom vocabulary and take a direct feed from the sound desk; ARC APAC Summit ran Snapsight across 20+ jargon-heavy healthcare sessions. Keep interpreters for sessions where certified accuracy matters most.

### How do you judge the quality of AI captioning before you buy?

Run a live trial on your own content, because a polished demo proves little. Check five things: clean audio from the sound desk or close mics, translation in every direction, audio and captions together, a glossary you control, and an attendee path with no app or account. Ask how the vendor measures quality; serious ones benchmark on BLEU, COMET and word error rate.

### What are the red flags when choosing an event translation platform?

There are eight. Your content trains their models; attendees must download an app or create an account; it only works with one meeting platform; there is no live trial or accuracy benchmark; they can’t explain their security controls; per-language or per-session charges are hidden; setup is measured in months; or your content disappears when the event ends.

### How do I use the vendor scorecard?

Score each shortlisted vendor 0, 1 or 2 on each of the twelve questions: 0 for no or no clear answer, 1 for a partial answer, 2 for a clear yes in writing. The highest of 24 points is your shortlist, and any red flag can rule a vendor out on its own.

### What should an event translation RFP include?

Your rooms, sessions, days and languages, and whether attendees need to read, listen or both. Then ask for written answers to the twelve questions in this guide. The emailed version of the guide includes an RFP you can paste into a vendor email.

## Enterprise controls, set to your policies.

Available on Enterprise and on request. Tell us what you need.

## Bring your security questions. We’ll go through them with you.

Book a review with our team, or start with the documents in our trust centre.

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Snapsight’s data hosted?

On AWS in Frankfurt, Germany, backups included. All Snapsight data moved there from AWS Singapore on 4 October 2024. Frankfurt is the default; other regions are available on request.

### Do you use our sessions to train AI models?

No. Session audio, transcripts and everything generated from them are never used to train AI models, and your data, including the IP in it, belongs to you. That commitment is in Snapsight’s privacy policy, terms of use and subscription agreement, and the services it uses process your content only to run Snapsight.

### Can we keep a closed session private?

Yes. Add an access code to the session, and only people with the code can open its live text and takeaways. Your content is never used to train AI models, and your data, including the IP in it, belongs to you.

### Which AI providers process our sessions?

Language models from Amazon Web Services, Microsoft, Google Cloud and AssemblyAI. Snapsight’s security page lists each one with what it does and where it processes data, as its trust centre and privacy policy do.

### Is our data encrypted?

Yes. All customer data on Snapsight is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.3.

### What can we send our IT team for review?

Snapsight’s SOC 2 Type II letter of attestation (covering GDPR and CCPA), its ISO 27001 certificate and its ISO 27017 and 27018 certificate download from the trust centre now. The full SOC 2 and ISO audit reports, the latest penetration test and vulnerability assessment reports, and the data flow and network diagrams are shared under NDA: request them in the trust centre or at cs@snapsight.com.

### Does Snapsight support single sign-on?

Yes, on the Enterprise plan. Your team signs in through your organisation’s identity provider, such as Microsoft Entra ID or Okta.

### Can we have our content deleted?

Yes, at any time: your content is yours. Email dpo@snapsight.com to delete specific sessions or close your account, and Snapsight removes the content from its active systems. The privacy policy explains what is kept for legal reasons.

### Does Snapsight run penetration tests?

Yes. Every year a CREST-certified vendor runs a vulnerability assessment and penetration test. Application penetration tests also follow any major platform update, and vulnerability scans run every week; the latest reports are shared under NDA.

### Is Snapsight GDPR compliant?

Yes. For GDPR, Snapsight’s EU representative under Article 27 is the European Data Protection Office (EDPO), and its Data Protection Officer is at dpo@snapsight.com.

## Frequently asked questions

### What does Snapsight do?

Snapsight builds AI for live events. It makes every session easier to follow while it happens, with live text, translation and takeaways on attendees’ phones, then makes what was said easy to find and use, with summaries, reports and speaker cards.

### Where is Snapsight based?

Snapsight is headquartered in Singapore. The team works from India, the United Kingdom, Europe and the United States.

### When did Snapsight launch?

Snapsight was first used at Business Events Industry Week in Chicago in April 2024, and launched officially at IMEX Frankfurt in May 2024. Remix followed in May 2026.

### Which products does Snapsight make?

Snapsight makes four products. Live translation lets attendees read free or listen for $10 per language per session; Takeaways and Idea Cloud give the key points during each talk; Remix drafts post-event reports, sponsor reports and decks; and Speaker Remix makes speakers’ own cards and posts.

### Which events use Snapsight?

Published stories include Economist Impact’s AI Innovation Asia, Informa Tech’s ATxEnterprise, Tech Week Singapore, ARC APAC Summit, The Decarbonised Mine and London Community Week, as well as IMEX, ICCA and The Meetings Show. Each story gives the event, what was run and what happened.

### Who does Snapsight partner with?

IAPCO names Snapsight a Service Provider Partner, the BestCities Global Alliance announced a two-year partnership in May 2025, and Freeman’s Key Takeaways for live events is powered by Snapsight. Agencies and AV companies resell it or run it under their own brand.

### How does Snapsight build its product?

Close to the event floor: the team spends time with organisers, speakers and attendees where Snapsight is used. Every insight stays tied to the session, speaker and moment it came from, and language, accessibility and format are part of the product from the start.

### Is Snapsight hiring?

Yes. Open roles across sales, customer success and engineering are listed on the careers page, each with its location and working arrangement.

## Writing about Snapsight? Everything you need is here.

The boilerplate, the facts, logos and images, ready to use.

About Snapsight

Snapsight is AI software for live events. One audio feed from each room gives every attendee live text, translation, key takeaways, an Idea Cloud and a summary on their own phone, from a QR code or link with no app. Afterwards, Remix turns the same sessions into post-event reports, sponsor reports and decks, and Speaker Remix gives each speaker a branded card and post to share. Snapsight is headquartered in Singapore.

**Headquarters**

Singapore

**Products**

Live translation, Takeaways and Idea Cloud, Remix, Speaker Remix

**Launched**

May 2024, at IMEX Frankfurt

Title: Senior Account Executive | Careers at Snapsight

[All open roles](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/careers#open-roles)

Sales

# Senior Account Executive

Lead complex sales for Snapsight, build relationships across event organisations, and help shape how the team wins and grows customer accounts.

**Team**

Sales

**Location**

India

**Workplace**

Remote

**Employment**

Full-time

**Openings**

1

Apply for this role

Share your CV, LinkedIn profile or portfolio link.

## The opportunity

We are hiring a Senior Account Executive to lead complex opportunities with event organisers, associations and corporate events teams. You will build a clear business case, bring the right people into the conversation, and guide customers from evaluation to a commercial decision.

This is a senior individual contributor role. Alongside your own pipeline, you will help sharpen our sales approach and coach teammates through discovery, demonstrations and deal strategy.

## What you will own

- Lead the full sales cycle for complex accounts: discovery, demonstrations, pilots, commercial proposals, negotiation and close.
- Build relationships with event leaders, budget owners and operational teams. Understand how decisions are made and bring each stakeholder into the process at the right time.
- Develop a pipeline through targeted outreach, inbound enquiries, event relationships and referrals, with a clear reason for each account to engage.
- Shape evaluations around measurable customer outcomes and a shared plan for reaching a decision.
- Navigate procurement, commercial terms and technical questions with support from the right teammates.
- Maintain credible forecasts in HubSpot and identify deal risks early, with a practical plan to address them.
- Coach Account Executives on discovery and deal strategy, and turn what works into useful examples for the team.
- Partner with customer success on a clear handover and opportunities to expand from one event to a wider programme.

## What you will bring

- A track record of personally winning B2B software or technology deals that involve several stakeholders and a considered buying process.
- Strong discovery and commercial judgement: you can uncover the real need, build a business case and negotiate a clear agreement.
- Confidence demonstrating software and adapting the conversation for both senior decision-makers and the people who will use the product.
- The ability to build your own pipeline, run several complex opportunities and forecast with discipline.
- Experience helping other sellers improve through specific feedback, deal reviews or shared practices.
- Clear writing, reliable follow-through and curiosity about AI and live events. Experience in SaaS or event technology is helpful.

## What good looks like

- Complex opportunities have a clear business case, engaged decision-makers and an agreed path to a decision.
- Forecasts reflect the evidence in each deal, and risks surface early enough to act on.
- New customers arrive with realistic expectations and a useful handover; successful approaches make the wider sales team stronger.

## The hiring conversation

Be ready to walk through a complex sale you owned: the stakeholders, the trade-offs and how you reached a decision. Our sales assessment uses a mock discovery and demo conversation to explore how you listen, handle objections and agree a next step. We will also discuss how you have helped other sellers improve.

## How to apply

Use the application form below. Share your CV, LinkedIn profile or portfolio link, and a short introduction if there is something you would like us to know. If someone introduced you to Snapsight, you can mention them in your introduction.

## Apply for this role.

Senior Account Executive

### Applications will open here soon.

We’re getting this application form ready. Please check back to apply.

Read our [privacy policy (opens in a new tab)](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/privacy-policy) for information about how we handle personal data.

Title: Account Executive | Careers at Snapsight

[All open roles](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/careers#open-roles)

Sales

# Account Executive

Own the sales conversation from discovery to a signed agreement. Help event organisers see what Snapsight can do for their audience, their content and their next event.

**Team**

Sales

**Location**

India

**Workplace**

Remote

**Employment**

Full-time

**Openings**

3

Apply for this role

Share your CV, LinkedIn profile or portfolio link.

## The opportunity

We are hiring three Account Executives to grow Snapsight with event organisers. You will understand what customers need, show how the product fits, and guide each opportunity through a pilot and a commercial decision.

This is a hands-on selling role. You should be comfortable learning the product, running your own demonstrations, following up with purpose and taking responsibility for the next step.

## What you will own

- Manage opportunities from discovery and demonstration through proposals, negotiation and close.
- Build pipeline through relevant outreach, inbound enquiries, event conversations and referrals. Research the account before you make contact.
- Understand the event programme, audience needs, content goals, buying process and the people involved in the decision.
- Run focused product demonstrations and agree what a successful pilot would need to prove.
- Handle questions about pricing, alternatives and timing with clear answers. Coordinate technical and procurement questions with the right teammates.
- Keep HubSpot current with decision criteria, next actions and realistic forecasts.
- Give customer success a useful handover: the promise made, the event requirements, the success measures and any unresolved questions.

## What you will bring

- Experience selling a B2B product or service, with examples of opportunities you have personally progressed and won.
- Strong discovery skills: you listen, ask precise questions and connect product capabilities to a business need.
- Confidence demonstrating software and learning enough of the product to answer practical questions.
- Clear writing, reliable follow-through and the organisation to manage several opportunities at once.
- Good commercial judgement and comfort discussing price, value and buying timelines.
- Curiosity about AI, live events and how customers turn conversations into useful content. Event technology or SaaS experience is helpful.

## What good looks like

- Customers understand why Snapsight fits their event and what they are evaluating.
- Your pipeline has credible next steps, clear decision-makers and dependable forecasts.
- Pilots move toward a timely decision, and new customers arrive with the context the success team needs.

## The hiring conversation

Be ready to talk through a sale you owned: how you found the need, handled a difficult moment and moved the opportunity forward. Our sales assessment uses a mock discovery and demo conversation to explore how you listen, respond to objections and agree a next step.

Sales

# Inbound Sales Development Representative

Be the first useful conversation a potential customer has with Snapsight. Read the inbound signal, qualify the opportunity and turn interest into a well-prepared meeting.

**Team**

Sales

**Location**

India

**Workplace**

Remote

**Employment**

Full-time

Apply for this role

Share your CV, LinkedIn profile or portfolio link.

## The opportunity

You will be the first person many potential customers speak with. Understand why they have come to us, qualify the opportunity and guide them to the right next step. This calls for judgement, product understanding and the confidence to answer initial questions or run a quick demonstration.

## What you will do

- Respond promptly to requests from our website, events, sign-ups, live chat and campaigns.
- Ask the right questions, qualify the opportunity and arrange a meeting or route it to the right sales representative.
- Explain Snapsight clearly, answer initial questions and run a brief product demonstration when needed.
- Keep HubSpot accurate: log activity, update stages, tag leads and write useful handover notes.
- Maintain reliable response and follow-up coverage for European and US business hours.
- Use quieter periods to revisit warm leads, research accounts and improve reporting and lead data.

## What you will bring

- Typically 1–3 years in sales development, customer success or another customer-facing role. Strong early-career candidates with practical experience are welcome.
- Working knowledge of HubSpot or a similar CRM, and the ability to manage leads independently.
- Good discovery and communication skills: listen closely, understand intent and adapt your explanation to the person.
- Speed, attention to detail and a reliable system for following up.
- An understanding of subscription software, customer journeys and recurring revenue.
- Practical familiarity with AI tools and the curiosity to understand an AI product beyond its headline features. Engineering experience is useful but not required.

## How success is measured

- Prompt, dependable responses across inbound channels.
- Qualified meetings and clear handovers that the sales team can act on.
- Complete CRM records, consistent tagging and useful pipeline data.
- Growing product knowledge and readiness to handle more of the sales conversation.

## Working arrangements and development

This is a full-time remote role. The work includes coverage of European and US business hours; discuss the exact schedule with the hiring team.

After one year, a formal performance review assesses eligibility to progress into an Account Executive role. Progression depends on execution, product knowledge and readiness to own more of the sales cycle.

## The hiring process

- A 20-minute phone screen about your background, interest in Snapsight and expectations for the role.
- A practical exercise over three days with three fictional inbound leads played by our hiring team. You decide how to research, prioritise, email, call and follow up.
- A 60-minute hiring-manager conversation and mock discovery call, including a chance to apply feedback.
- A founder conversation where a final discussion is needed.

Use the application form below. Share your CV, LinkedIn profile or portfolio link, and a short introduction if there is something you would like us to know. If someone introduced you to Snapsight, you can mention them in your introduction.

# Customer Success Representative

Help customers run successful events with Snapsight. Own onboarding, live remote support and the delivery of useful content after the last session.

**Team**

Customer Success

**Location**

India

**Workplace**

Remote

**Employment**

Full-time

**Openings**

2

Apply for this role

Share your CV, LinkedIn profile or portfolio link.

## The opportunity

We are hiring two Customer Success Representatives, reporting to the Customer Success Manager. You will own the customer experience from a sale or pilot through event preparation, live support and post-event delivery.

You will work directly with international clients. A well-run first event gives them the confidence to use Snapsight again.

## What you will do

- Own the shared support inbox during your shift, with a first response within 4–6 hours.
- Onboard pilots: prepare agendas and sessions, run walkthroughs and demonstrations, and coordinate technical briefings.
- Provide remote standby during live events and respond to urgent issues in minutes through the agreed event support channel.
- Check transcripts and coordinate Remix content, reports and post-event delivery within five business days.
- Support subscribed customers with configuration, SSO, role-based access and feature follow-ups, involving engineering when needed.
- Keep Notion runbooks current and cover teammates’ accounts during leave.
- Use AI tools thoughtfully for drafting, triage and reporting, checking the work before it reaches a customer.

## What you will bring

- 2–4 years in customer success, support or event operations, ideally in B2B SaaS.
- Clear, warm written English and confidence working with international customers.
- Calm judgement when a live session has a problem: understand the impact, communicate and coordinate the response.
- Comfort with live event technology and streaming basics, or evidence that you learn technical tools quickly.
- The organisation to manage several events at once and keep commitments visible.

## Working hours

Fully remote in India. The regular schedule is 14:30–23:30 IST, Monday to Friday, covering Europe and US East business hours.

Live events can extend later or occasionally start early. The role includes a rotation for out-of-hours escalations.

## Success in your first 90 days

- Run pilots from onboarding through delivery with increasing independence.
- Meet the response commitments and keep customers informed when an issue needs more time.
- Deliver complete post-event content within five business days.
- Turn recurring customer questions into better documentation and a smoother next event.

Use the application form below. Share your CV, LinkedIn profile or portfolio link, and a short introduction if there is something you would like us to know. If someone introduced you to Snapsight, you can mention them in your introduction.

# Full Stack Engineer

Build the software behind Snapsight’s live and post-event experience. Take useful product ideas from interface and API through to reliable production behaviour.

**Team**

Engineering

**Location**

India

**Workplace**

Remote

**Employment**

Full-time

**Hiring**

Ongoing opportunities

Apply for this role

Share your CV, LinkedIn profile or portfolio link.

## The opportunity

We are always interested in full stack engineers who enjoy owning a product problem end to end. This is an ongoing opportunity to introduce yourself; the scope and timing of a role will depend on the team’s needs and your experience.

The work spans customer-facing interfaces, backend services and the connections between them. We care about what you have built, the decisions you made and how the result behaved for real users.

## The work you could own

- Build complete product features across interfaces, APIs and data storage.
- Make onboarding, session setup and content workflows easier to understand and use.
- Integrate services that turn live conversations into transcription, translation, takeaways and post-event content.
- Improve performance, reliability and visibility into failures, including the behaviour users see when a dependency is slow or unavailable.
- Build and maintain integrations with the tools customers already use.
- Work with product, design and customer success to understand problems, ship improvements and learn from production usage.

## What you will bring

- Experience shipping and maintaining web applications across frontend and backend. Share a project you can discuss in depth.
- Sound foundations in JavaScript or TypeScript, a modern frontend framework, APIs and databases.
- The ability to debug across system boundaries and reason about performance, access control and failure handling.
- Care for understandable interfaces, maintainable code and tests that protect important behaviour.
- Comfort working through an unclear problem, explaining trade-offs and asking for context when needed.
- Curiosity about AI products and responsible use of coding tools, with ownership of the code and its behaviour.

## Useful experience

- Streaming or real-time systems, background processing and third-party service integrations.
- Production monitoring, automated delivery and cloud infrastructure.
- Accessible interfaces and products used by customers across different languages and devices.

## Tell us about your work

A portfolio, GitHub profile or CV is welcome. Public code is optional: if your work is private, describe a product or feature you owned, your contribution and one important trade-off. Please do not share a previous employer’s confidential code or customer information.

Use the application form below. Share your CV, LinkedIn profile or portfolio link, and a short introduction if there is something you would like us to know. If someone introduced you to Snapsight, you can mention them in your introduction.

Title: Privacy Policy | Snapsight

# Privacy Policy

*Last Updated: 20 June 2026*

This Privacy Policy covers the practices of Snapsight ("we", "us", or "our") concerning the collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information when you use our services and the choices you have regarding your information. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information.

By using Snapsight and its services, you agree to the collection and use of your information as described in this Privacy Policy. If you have any questions or concerns about our policy or practices, please contact us at [dpo@snapsight.com](mailto:dpo@snapsight.com)

## Definitions:

"User Materials" refers to all content that you post, upload, or otherwise submit to the Platform, as defined in our Terms of Use.

"Customer Materials" refers to all content uploaded or submitted by clients to the platform, as defined in our Subscription Agreement.

"Generated Insights" refers to any insights, summaries, analyses, or other content generated by the Platform based on your User Materials or Customer Materials.

## 1. Information We Collect

We collect personal information from you when you interact with our services, such as when you:

- Create an account or signup for our services.
- Contact our support team
- Participate in surveys, promotions, or events

The information we collect may include:

### 1.1. Personal Information

- Contact information, such as your name, email address, and phone number
- Account information, such as your username, password, and preferences
- Billing information, such as your credit card details and billing address
- User Materials and Customer Materials, which may include audio recordings, transcripts, and other content you upload or submit to the Platform

We shall keep all Personal Information confidential and shall only process Personal Information on behalf of and in accordance with your instructions.

For the avoidance of doubt, we will only comply with such instructions that are not in contravention with the applicable laws, including but not limited to privacy and/or data protection laws enforceable at the time. To avoid confusion, rest assured that any Non-personal Information combined with Personal Information shall be regarded as Personal information.

For Singapore-based Users: For the purposes of our services, we consider the information provided during user sign-up, including but not limited to name and email address, to be "Business Contact Information." This classification applies regardless of whether the user is acting in a personal or professional capacity when creating an account. We treat and protect this information in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA)

### 1.2. Usage Information

- Events you create, content you generate, and your interactions with our platform
- Information about your device, browser, and operating system
- Your IP address, browsing history, and other usage data

### 1.3. Information from Third Parties

- We may receive information about you from third parties, such as social media platforms, if you choose to connect your account to these services

### 1.4. Cookies and Similar Technologies

We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect and store information about your interaction with our platform. Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device by your web browser. We use both session and persistent cookies, as well as first-party and third-party cookies, for various purposes, such as:

- Remembering your login information and preferences
- Analyzing platform usage and trends to improve our services
- Delivering personalized content.

You can manage your cookie preferences or opt-out of cookies through your browser settings. However, please note that disabling cookies may affect your experience and the functionality of our platform.

### 1.5 User Materials and Customer Materials

We collect and process User Materials and Customer Materials as necessary to provide our services. This may include:

- Audio recordings of events or meetings
- Transcripts of recordings
- Any other content you choose to upload or create on the Platform We treat these materials with the utmost confidentiality and use them solely for the purpose of providing and improving our services.

## 2. How We Use Your Information

We use the personal data we collect for various purposes, including:

- Register you as a user of the Platform
- To process and analyze User Materials and Customer Materials solely for the purpose of delivering our services and generating insights relevant to your specific use case. Your materials remain confidential and are not used to train or improve Al models.
- To notify you about changes to our Service and provide important account information, including subscription expiration and renewal notices.
- To offer customer support
- To provide you with news, special offers, and general information about other goods, services, or events we offer that are similar to those you have already purchased or inquired about, unless you have opted not to receive such information

### 2.1 Use of User Materials, Customer Materials, and Generated Insights

We use User Materials and Customer Materials solely for the purpose of providing and improving our services. This includes:

- Generating transcripts and insights from audio recordings
- Analyzing content to provide valuable summaries and key points

Generated Insights belong to you, and you have the right to use, modify, distribute, and exploit these Generated Insights as you see fit. We will not use your uploaded content, User Materials, or Generated Content to train Al models.

### 2.2 Safeguarding Your Data from Al Training Use

Under no circumstances shall the User Materials, Customer Materials, or any content derived from the usage of the Platform be employed by GSI for the purpose of training LLM's(Large Language Model) or for any purpose other than providing the services, ensuring strict confidentiality and non-use for such purposes. GSI will not sell your User Materials, Customer Materials, or Generated Insights, or use them for purposes unrelated to the Platform without your explicit consent.

## 3. Legal Basis for Processing

We process your personal information based on one or more of the following legal grounds:

- Your consent
- The performance of a contract or to take steps at your request before entering into a contract

## 4. Sharing Your Information

We ensure that our third-party service providers maintain an adequate level of data protection and privacy by including contractual agreements and requiring adherence to specific data protection frameworks, such as the ISO 27001.

### 4.1. Service Providers

- We engage third-party service providers to help us operate and maintain our platform, such as hosting, payment processing, analytics, and customer support services

### 4.2. Legal Requirements and Business Transfers

- We may disclose your personal information to law enforcement or government agencies when required by law or to protect our users and services
- In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of our assets, we may transfer your personal information to the relevant parties.

### 4.3 User Materials and Customer Materials

We treat User Materials and Customer Materials as strictly confidential. We do not share, sell, or distribute these materials to any third parties except as necessary to provide our services (such as using secure cloud storage providers). Any third-party service providers who may have access to these materials are bound by strict confidentiality agreements.

## 5. Data Retention

We retain your information including User Materials and Customer Materials for as long as necessary to provide our services and as required by law. The license you grant us to use your User Content (as defined in our Terms of Use) exists only for as long as you choose to keep your User Content on the Platform.

You have the following options to control the retention of your materials:

1. Content Removal: You can request the deletion of specific User Materials or Customer Materials at any time by contacting us at [dpo@snapsight.com](mailto:dpo@snapsight.com).
2. Account Closure: You may revoke the license and request the removal of all your User Content by closing your account. To close your account, please contact us at [dpo@snapsight.com](mailto:dpo@snapsight.com) or use the account closure option in your account settings, if available.

Upon your request for deletion or account closure, we will remove all copies of your materials from our active systems and cease any further use or distribution of the content. However, please note:

1. Residual Copies: GSI may retain, but not display, distribute, or perform, server copies of your User Content that have been removed or deleted. These residual copies are kept for technical and legal purposes only.
2. Legal Retention: We may be required to retain certain information for legal or regulatory purposes, even after you have requested deletion or closed your account. In such cases, we will only retain the minimum necessary information and continue to protect it in accordance with this Privacy Policy.
3. Anonymized Data: We may retain anonymized or aggregated data derived from your User Materials or Customer Materials for the purpose of improving our services, as long as this data cannot be used to identify you or your content specifically.

If you have any questions about our data retention practices or wish to request the deletion of your data, please contact us at [dpo@snapsight.com](mailto:dpo@snapsight.com).

### 5.1. Sub processors

snapsight makes use of third parties Sub-processors to provide specific functions with in the Services. The Sub-providers and their purposes are listed as below. In order to provide the relevant functionality these Sub-processors access Service Data only for the use of the indicated services.

## 6. Data Security

We take the security of your personal information seriously and implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect it from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. Our security measures include:

- Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) encryption to protect the transmission of your sensitive information
- Secure server infrastructure with firewalls and intrusion detection/prevention systems
- Regular security reviews and vulnerability assessments to ensure the ongoing protection of our systems
- Limiting access to your personal information to employees, contractors, and service providers who need the information to perform their job duties and who are subject to strict contractual confidentiality obligations
- Employee training and awareness programs to promote a culture of security and privacy

However, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information.

### 6.1. Data Breach Notification Process

In the event of a data breach, we will promptly investigate and take appropriate steps to mitigate the impact of the breach. We will notify affected users and relevant authorities, as required by applicable laws, within a reasonable timeframe. Our notification will include information about the nature of the breach, the steps we have taken in response, and any recommended actions for users to protect their personal information.

## 7. International Data Transfers

As a global company, we may transfer, process, and store your personal information in countries outside of your country of residence. By using our services, you consent to the transfer of your information to these countries. We will take steps to ensure that your information receives an adequate level of protection in accordance with this Privacy Policy and applicable data protection laws.

## 8. Your Rights and Choices

You have certain rights regarding your personal information, subject to local data protection laws. These may include:

- The right to access, update, or delete your personal information
- The right to restrict or object to the processing of your personal information
- The right to withdraw your consent, where applicable
- The right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority

### 8.1. California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Rights

If you are a California resident, you have specific rights under the CCPA, including the right to:

- Know what personal information we collect, use, disclose, and sell
- Access and obtain a copy of your personal information
- Request the deletion of your personal information
- Opt-out of the sale of your personal information (if applicable)
- Not be discriminated against for exercising your CCPA rights

To exercise your CCPA rights or learn more about your privacy options, please contact us at [dpo@snapsight.com](mailto:dpo@snapsight.com)

### 8.2. General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Rights

If you are a resident of the European Union, you have specific rights under the GDPR, including the right to:

- Access, correct, update, or request deletion of your personal information
- Object to the processing of your personal information
- Restrict the processing of your personal information
- Request the transfer of your personal information to another service provider (data portability)
- Withdraw your consent at any time (if we rely on your consent to process your personal information)

To exercise your GDPR rights or learn more about your privacy options, please contact [dpo@snapsight.com](mailto:dpo@snapsight.com)

## 9. Third-Party Links

Our platform may contain links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these third parties. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party sites you visit.

## 10. EU Representative Contact

Pursuant to Article 27 of Europe's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), GlobalSign.In Pte Ltd in has appointed European Data Protection Office (EDPO) as its GDPR representative in the EU. You can contact EDPO regarding matters pertaining to the GDPR by sending an email to privacy@edpo.brussels, using EDPO's [online request form](https://edpo.com/gdpr-data-request/), or writing to EDPO at Avenue Huart Hamoir 71, 1030 Brussels, Belgium.

## 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, legal requirements, or other factors. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting a notice on our website or by contacting you directly. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about our practices.

## 12. Contact Us

# Subscription Agreement

*Last Updated: 31-Jul-2024*

## 1. Definitions

**"GlobalSign.In Pte. Ltd" or "GSI"** is an event tech company that is located at their registered address, 28 Genting Lane, #01-01 Platinum 28, Singapore 349585 with Company Registration Number 200704830D and for the purposes of this agreement referred to as "GSI" where applicable.

**"Customer"** means any individual or entity that purchases, subscribes to, or otherwise acquires access to the Platform, including but not limited to end-users, resellers, and distributors.

**"Subscription Plan"** means the plan chosen by the Customer, as specified in the Order Form, which includes a specified number of Session Credits and a subscription period (1 year, 2 years, etc.).

**"Order Form"** means the document provided by GSI and signed by the Customer, detailing the specifics of the Subscription Plan, including the number of sessions.

**"Snapsight", "Snapsight by Gevme" or "Platform"** means the platform or software owned by GSI, which helps the Customer to analyze real-time streaming content to provide key insights and summaries. It enhances engagement and understanding during live sessions, and allows for the sharing and display of these key insights and summaries to the attendees. Snapsight is accessible at [www.snapsight.com](https://www.snapsight.com/).

**"Site"** means the use of [www.snapsight.com](https://www.snapsight.com/), including our various top­level domains, as well as various sub­domains and aliases of these domains, whether as a visitor or as a user of Snapsight.

**"GST"** means the Goods and Services Tax Act (Cap. 117A of Singapore).

**"Users"** means your employees, representatives, consultants, contractors or agents who are authorised to use the Platform for your benefit and have unique user identifications and passwords for the Platform.

**"Generated Insights"** refers to any insights, summaries, analyses, or other content generated by the Platform based on the Customer Materials.

**"Customer Materials"** refers specifically to all content uploaded or submitted by the client to the platform, such as recordings from their events.

**"Session Credits"** are allocated to customers on Snapsight. These credits enable customers to utilize platform features, such as real-time content analysis and engagement enhancements during live sessions. The amount of Session Credits available to Customers is determined by the Subscription Plan they signed up for, according to the Order form they signed and agreed upon with GSI, or by purchasing session credits directly on the website.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Snapsight?

Snapsight is AI software for live events. It listens to each session’s audio feed and gives attendees live text, translation and key takeaways on their own phones, then helps the organiser turn the same sessions into reports, posts and speaker cards with Remix. Attendees scan a QR code or open a link; there is no app to download.

### Who is Snapsight for?

Event organisers of every kind: trade shows and exhibitions, conferences and congresses, associations, corporate summits, community events and festivals. Agencies, PCOs and AV companies resell it or run it under their own brand for clients. Published stories include Economist Impact, Informa Tech’s ATxEnterprise, Tech Week Singapore, ARC APAC Summit and London Community Week.

### Is Snapsight free to use at an event?

Live text translation is free for every event, with no trial clock: every room at once, up to 10 languages per session, and 100 sessions a year. Voice translation is $10 per language per session. Live takeaways, summaries and transcript downloads come with Pro at $249 per session, less in packs, and the $199 Engage event pass adds your branding, sponsor logos and Q&A moderation across the whole event.

### How is Snapsight different from a translation app or an AI notetaker?

Translation apps and notetakers are personal tools that each attendee runs for themselves. Snapsight runs once per session for the whole room: one feed from the sound desk gives every attendee live text in their language, takeaways that link back to the speaker’s words, and a summary. The organiser keeps the record and can turn it into reports, posts and speaker cards.

### What do attendees need to follow a session?

Only their own phone and a browser. They scan the session’s QR code or open its link, pick a language and read along; to listen to a translated voice, they use their own earbuds. Snapsight can also sit inside your event app.

### What can we make from our sessions after the event?

Snapsight’s Remix drafts post-event reports, sponsor reports, LinkedIn carousels, one-pagers and decks from the sessions you pick, with every quote tied to its speaker and session. Speaker Remix gives each speaker a branded card and a draft post from their own talk. Attendees keep the takeaways and summaries to catch up on what they missed.

### Is our event content safe with Snapsight?

Snapsight never trains AI models on your content, and your data, including the IP in it, belongs to you: the transcripts, takeaways and summaries too. Free translation runs on the same infrastructure as Snapsight’s enterprise deployments, and regional data residency and single sign-on are available on request. The security page and trust centre have the details.

### Can we try Snapsight before our event?

Yes. Open a real event session on the experience page with no form, start free with live text on one of your own sessions, or ask Snapsight to test it live with your speaker in the languages your audience needs.
